entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling about a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought. I think I need to return it, but I'm not really sure how it all works.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, it works fine! I guess I just... I completely changed my mind. To be honest, it was an impulse buy, and I really don't use it like I thought I would. The website was a bit confusing, and I feel a little lost. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can help. No problem at all. Let me just pull up your order information and review our current return policy for you. Could you please provide your order number or the email address used for the purchase?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It was delivered on December 15th, so you've had it for about 17 days.
Yes, that sounds right. I'm sorry, I just feel so overwhelmed with it all.

Please, don't worry about it. I've checked our policy, and you have 90 days from the delivery date to make a return. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely process this for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you so much!

You're very welcome. I'm sending the return instructions and a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file right now. Just put the sensor back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. We don't have a specific policy on the need for resale or anything like that within this window.
That's perfect and sounds so easy. You've been a great help, David.

I'm happy I could resolve this for you. Your refund will be issued back to your original payment method once we receive the item, which usually takes 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
